segments.t: After surviving his accidental hanging, Max sincerely apologizes to Victoria for his foolish stunt. He begs her for another chance to prove his love. Let's listen closely to the conversation in Russian first, and then walk through each line together.
Спасибо, что спас меня.
Какой же ты дурак.
Думаешь, это смешные шутки?
Вика, прости меня, пожалуйста.
Я реально очень сильно облажался.
Я просто не хочу тебя терять.
У меня есть хоть маленький шанс?
Я сделаю всё, что ты скажешь.
Я больше не верю твоим словам.
Но я говорю тебе правду.
Тебе нужно измениться.
Я обещаю, я изменюсь.
Ещё раз прости меня.
Now let's go back through the exchange around Apologies line by line and unpack how the Russian works.
Спасибо, что спас меня.
'Thank you for saving me.' Catching his breath on the floor, Max thanks Vika and Kostya for saving his life.
Какой же ты дурак.
'What a fool you are.' Shaken, Vika shakes her head at what a complete fool he is.
Думаешь, это смешные шутки?
'Do you think these are funny jokes?' She asks if he really thinks stunts like that are funny.
Вика, прости меня, пожалуйста.
'Vika, forgive me, please.' Max sincerely begs Vika to forgive him.
Я реально очень сильно облажался.
'I really screwed up badly.' He admits without excuses that he messed up terribly.
Я просто не хочу тебя терять.
'I simply do not want to lose you.' Max tells her softly that he simply does not want to lose her.
У меня есть хоть маленький шанс?
'Do I have even a small chance?' He asks whether he still has even a tiny chance to make things right.
Я сделаю всё, что ты скажешь.
'I will do everything that you say.' Max promises to do whatever she asks of him.
Я больше не верю твоим словам.
'I no longer believe your words.' Vika replies honestly that she can no longer trust his promises.
Но я говорю тебе правду.
'But I am telling you the truth.' Max insists that he is telling her the truth this time.
Тебе нужно измениться.
'You need to change.' Softening slightly, Vika tells him that he truly needs to grow up and change.
Я обещаю, я изменюсь.
'I promise, I will change.' Max swears to her that he will change for good.
Ещё раз прости меня.
'Once again, forgive me.' He apologizes once more for everything he put her through. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

Victoria remains skeptical of his promises, leaving Max desperate to show that he can truly change his immature behavior. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'to save' and 'fool' — you will catch every word right away. See you next time!
